one_line: Wealthy setthi and principal donor of the great chaitya hall at Karla Cave, amid a diverse circle of merchants and rulers.

appearance.age_look: Early 40s, medium height, sturdy merchant’s build with confident posture.
appearance.face: Oval face, warm medium-brown Deccan complexion, straight nose, neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, sharp but kind eyes with a calm, assessing gaze; default expression is dignified and slightly thoughtful, as if weighing a deal.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair parted slightly off-center, combed back and tied into a modest low knot at the nape; front kept smooth without loose strands; simple narrow cream cloth headband wraps horizontally around the head above the forehead, knotted at the back with small tails.
appearance.costume: He wears an early historic Deccan merchant’s ensemble: a knee-length, long-sleeved tunic (like a close-fitting uttariya-chaddar) of fine unpatterned ivory-white cotton reaching mid-thigh, side-slit for movement, worn over a wrapped lower garment—pale saffron-yellow cotton dhoti, pleated and tied at the waist and falling to the ankles; over his left shoulder and across the chest is a draped shawl of soft, slightly heavier cotton in deep indigo blue, its end hanging to mid-calf at the back, edges simply hemmed without decoration; feet in plain brown leather sandals with a toe loop and single strap; jewellery restricted to a pair of small gold stud earrings, a single medium-thickness gold neck torc sitting close to the neck, and two narrow gold bangles on the right wrist; he carries a simple cloth merchant’s belt pouch at his waist in dull brown, subtly bulging with tablets or coins, with no metal fittings.
appearance.signature: A rolled palm-leaf manuscript bundle tied with a thin cord, carried in his left hand, edges slightly fanned to show layered leaves, representing his donation records and vows for the Karla chaitya hall.

ref_desc: Bhutapala is a sturdy, medium-brown, oval-faced merchant with a short beard, black hair in a low knot and cream headband, wearing an ivory tunic, saffron dhoti, indigo shoulder shawl, brown sandals, modest gold jewellery, and holding a rolled palm-leaf manuscript.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character model sheet of Bhutapala of Vaijayanti: a sturdy early-40s merchant from the Deccan with a medium-brown oval face, calm sharp eyes, and a short neatly trimmed beard and moustache. His black hair is combed back and tied into a low knot at the nape, encircled by a simple narrow cream cloth headband above the forehead. He wears an ivory-white knee-length long-sleeved tunic of plain cotton over a wrapped pale saffron-yellow dhoti that falls to his ankles, both era-accurate and modestly covering his body. A deep indigo blue cotton shawl is draped from his left shoulder across the chest, with the end hanging down his back to mid-calf. His feet are in plain brown leather sandals with a toe loop and a single strap. Jewellery is minimal and historically plausible: small gold stud earrings, one close-fitting gold neck torc, and two narrow gold bangles on his right wrist. A simple brown cloth belt pouch sits at his waist. In his left hand he prominently holds a rolled palm-leaf manuscript bundle tied with a thin cord, his signature prop symbolizing donation records. Show him in neutral turnaround-friendly poses with consistent colours and details, emphasizing the ivory tunic, saffron dhoti, indigo shawl, cream headband, brown sandals, gold accents, and the palm-leaf manuscript as the key elements of his design.
